# Medicare levy

Find out about the Medicare levy and if you are eligible for an exemption or reduction.

[**What is the Medicare levy?**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/what-is-the-medicare-levy)

The Medicare levy is an amount you pay in addition to the tax you pay on your taxable income.

[**Medicare levy exemption**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/medicare-levy-exemption)

Find out about Medicare levy exemptions for medical conditions, foreign residents or entitlement to Medicare benefits.

[**Medicare levy reduction**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/medicare-levy-reduction)

Find out if you are eligible for a Medicare levy reduction based on your income or family income.
